title: Speech library behavior
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Auritus as an embeddable speech library

  Scenario: Synthesize speech with a typed request
    Given the "fake" speech backend is installed
    When I synthesize "Hello there. [[auritus:break]] Welcome." with voice "fake:plain"
    Then I receive WAV audio with its sample rate and duration
    And the result lists 2 timed segments
    And the result records the auritus version, backend, model and voice

  Scenario: The request key is stable and sensitive to every input
    When I compute request keys for the same text, voice and options twice
    Then the keys are equal
    And changing the text, voice, speed or seed changes the key

  Scenario: A missing backend fails loudly
    Given the "chatterbox" backend's dependencies are not installed
    When I synthesize "Hello" with voice "chatterbox:default"
    Then a BackendUnavailable error names the missing dependency
    And no audio is produced

  Scenario: Reference voices come only from an explicit folder
    Given a voices folder containing "narrator.wav" and "narrator.txt"
    And the current directory contains "impostor.wav"
    When I list reference voices from that folder
    Then "narrator" is listed
    And "impostor" is not listed

  Scenario: Non-commercial backends need an explicit opt-in
    When I synthesize "Hello" with voice "fish:narrator" without allowing non-commercial use
    Then a LicenseRestricted error explains the backend's licence

  Scenario: Speak offline from the command line
    Given no Auritus login or AWS credentials
    When I run "auritus speak 'Hello' --voice fake:plain -o out.wav --json"
    Then "out.wav" is a WAV file
    And "out.wav.json" records sample rate, duration, segments, provenance and request key
```
